reasons.plausibility: This tribocorrosion mechanism (oxide removal exposing reactive phases to galvanic attack) is well-documented and scientifically sound for multi-phase alloys at elevated temperature, making the hypothesis fully convincing.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparison of simultaneous wear–corrosion versus corrosion-only, with quantitative measurements of weight loss and interface damage, offers a clear falsification criterion and a decisive way to confirm or refute the mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses how to isolate and quantify the role of oxide disruption in accelerated corrosion, providing a clear experimental route and new insights for high-entropy alloy design under harsh service conditions.
